name: Sardis
overview: Sardis is identified as one of the seven churches in Asia addressed by Christ in Revelation, where He acknowledges their reputation for life but declares them spiritually dead. The church is exhorted to be watchful, strengthen what remains, and repent, as their works are not found perfect before God. Despite this, a faithful remnant in Sardis remains undefiled and is promised to walk with Christ in white, signifying purity and worthiness. This message underscores the necessity of genuine spiritual vitality and perseverance in the Christian walk.
